# Alpha Rock

> Alpha Rock is a men's dietary supplement marketed to support healthy circulation, everyday energy and vitality through a daily two-capsule formula of amino acids, botanical extracts and micronutrients. It is a dietary supplement, not a drug, and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Alpha Rock is intended for adult men (18+). Statements about the product have not been evaluated by the FDA. Always consult a physician before starting any new supplement, particularly if you take medication or manage a health condition.
